title.narrative: To get to Zero Indigenous case by 2022 and sustain it thereafter to achieve Malaria elimination by 2025 - Nepal (16-Mar-2021-31-Jan-2025)

description.narrative: Nepal, Malaria, Save the Children Federation, Inc. (STC HQ)This program has the following goals: Reduce the indigenous cases to zero by 2022 and sustain zero malaria mortality. The objectives of this program are: Strengthen surveillance and strategic information on malaria for effective decision making. Ensure effective coverage of vector control intervention in the targeted malaria risk areas. Ensure universal access to quality assured diagnosis and effective treatment for malaria. Develop and sustain support from leadership and communities towards malaria elimination. Strengthen programmatic technical and managerial capacities towards malaria elimination
